title: Algebra & Trigonometry Mastery Quiz
description: 10 fundamental questions evaluating quadratic formulas, discriminants, and trigonometric identities.

questions.questionText: What is the discriminant of the quadratic equation 2x^2 - 4x + 2 = 0?
What is the value of sin(90° - θ)?
questions.explanation: By complementary angle identities, sin(90° - θ) = cos(θ).

questions.questionText: If the roots of ax^2 + bx + c = 0 are real and equal, what condition must hold?
questions.explanation: A quadratic equation has real and equal roots when the discriminant is zero.

questions.questionText: The value of tan(45°) is equal to 1.
questions.explanation: In a right-angled isosceles triangle, tan(45°) = 1.

questions.questionText: A quadratic equation can have three distinct roots in the complex number field.
questions.explanation: A degree 2 polynomial has at most 2 distinct roots.

questions.questionText: The standard quadratic formula for ax^2 + bx + c = 0 has numerator -b ± √(______).
questions.explanation: The discriminant expression under the radical is b^2 - 4ac.

questions.questionText: In a right triangle, the ratio of opposite side to hypotenuse is called the ______ function.
questions.explanation: Sine is defined as opposite side over hypotenuse.
